snippet.title: Swords of Legends - Gameplay Trailer | Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4729320/

Returned to the mortal realm by the Judge of King Yama, you walk again as a Sipan—an Arbiter of the Underworld, sent to seek out souls who cannot find their way home. Listen to their stories. Sever the worldly ties that bind them. Ferry each soul across the sea of birth and death.

Official Website: https://www.swordsoflegends.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Gujiangame
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/swordsoflegends
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@swordsoflegends
